title: Human Resources (HR) – Volunteer For NGO
description:
About Us

**GiveWise Educational Foundation** is a vision‑driven NGO focused on building a structured, ethical, and student‑first education system. We aim to create a professional and stress‑free working culture inspired by global standards.

Role Overview

We are looking for a dedicated and responsible HR team member who will help us in building and managing our core team, ensuring smooth onboarding, engagement, and coordination.

Key Responsibilities

* Handle recruitment and outreach (teachers, volunteers, coordinators)
* Screen applications and schedule initial interactions
* Manage onboarding process (documents, forms, communication)

* Support in engagement, follow\-ups, and coordination

* Real experience in HR operations and team building

* Opportunity to work closely with leadership
* Certificate \& recognition (based on performance)

* Mode: Remote
* Working Hours: Flexible (primarily after 5 PM)

title: Human Resources Coordinator
description:
**Human Resources Coordinator**

**Location:** Remote

**Job Title:** Human Resources Coordinator

**Reports To:** HR Business Partner (U.S.\-Based)

**Compensation:** ₹70,000

**About Us**

Summerfield Property Management (SPM) is a growing U.S.\-based property management firm delivering exceptional living experiences across a diverse residential portfolio. As we grow, we are building an HR function that operates with precision, compliance, and efficiency to support our U.S. workforce.

By joining SPM, you gain direct exposure to U.S. HR practices, leadership, and operational standards, while contributing meaningfully to a growing organization.

**Position Summary**

We are seeking an experienced HR Coordinator with proven U.S. HR experience to manage core HR operations independently. This is a hands\-on role for someone who has already worked for a U.S.\-based company or supported U.S. employees remotely. You will support HR processes end\-to\-end, ensuring flawless onboarding, compliance, employee documentation, and recruiting coordination.

You will report directly to the U.S.\-based HR Business Partner, providing an opportunity to learn, collaborate, and align with U.S. HR standards while playing a critical operational role.

*If you have managed HR operations for a U.S. company, understand I\-9s, U.S. benefits, and U.S. HR compliance, and thrive in remote work, this role is for you.*

**Key Responsibilities**

**Employee Onboarding \& Compliance**

* Manage end\-to\-end onboarding for U.S.\-based employees, including offer letters, background checks, and I\-9 documentation
* Ensure 100% completion, accuracy, and audit readiness of employee records
* Handle offboarding processes and documentation in compliance with U.S. standards

**HR Systems \& Data Management**

* Maintain accurate, up\-to\-date employee records in HRIS
* Track HR metrics, deadlines, and compliance documentation
* Proactively identify and fix gaps in HR processes

**Benefits \& Employee Support**

* Assist with U.S.\-based benefits enrollment and administration
* Respond to employee inquiries accurately and professionally
* Escalate complex issues to the HR Business Partner as needed

**Recruiting \& Hiring Coordination**

* Manage job postings, applicant tracking, and interview scheduling
* Ensure a professional and seamless candidate experience
* Coordinate with hiring managers across U.S. time zones

**HR Operations \& Process Excellence**

* Provide operational and administrative support to the U.S. HR team
* Identify opportunities to improve efficiency and process consistency
* Execute HR operations independently with minimal oversight

**Qualifications**

**Required Experience**

* 2\+ years in HR operations, HR coordination, or HR administration
* Managed onboarding, offboarding, compliance, and documentation for U.S. employees
* Familiarity with HRIS, ATS, and HR documentation systems
* Experience supporting U.S. benefits administration, payroll coordination, or HR policies
* Strong professional English communication skills (written and verbal)

**Professional Skills**

* Strong ownership mindset and ability to work independently
* High attention to detail and organizational skills
* Ability to work remotely and collaborate effectively with a U.S.\-based team
* Reliable high\-speed internet connection and dedicated workspace required

**Work Schedule**

* Must be willing to work a schedule aligned with U.S. East Coast hours (overlap with EST required)

**Compensation \& Benefits**

We offer a competitive salary and the following benefits:

* Competitive monthly salary based on location and experience
* Paid Time Off and paid holidays
* Performance\-based bonuses tied to execution and reliability
* Professional development and training opportunities
* Flexible remote work environment
* Opportunity to work with a growing U.S. property management firm

*Join our team and be a key player in building world\-class HR operations at SPM.*

*SPM is an equal opportunity employer. We encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply today!*

Job Types: Full\-time, Permanent

Pay: ₹70,000\.00 per month

Work Location: Remote

title: Location Manager_Secured_Giridih
description:
Designation: Manager


Location: India Jharkhand Harsh Plaza, Giridhi


Organization: Financial Services

**Job Description:**
--------------------


1\) Job Purpose: *Write the purpose for which the job exists (in 2\-3 lines)* (Max 1325 Characters)

  

The purpose of this job is to plan area (city/ branch) sales and business growth with the Territory Head (Sales) and achieve set targets through the team while complying with sales processes and guidelines at all times. It takes joint approval decisions with Risk counterpart as per approval matrix, and works with Risk, Operations and Sales Governance teams to ensure portfolio health. It works to support business profitability by addressing underperformance, adopting process improvements, capitalizing on channel optimization opportunities, etc. It intervenes as required in specific cases/ exceptions and helps address bottlenecks for the achievement of sales targets, hand\-holding team members on complex cases. It also drives cross\-selling across ABFL and ABFSG products/ solutions as per regional plans and unique client requirements.

  


3\) Job Context \& Major Challenges: Write the specific aspects of the job that provide a challenge (internal and external) to the jobholder in the context of the Business/Unit/Function/Department/Section ((Max 3975 Characters)

 **Organizational Context**


Key Aspects:

* **As the debt arm of Aditya Birla Capital (ABC), Aditya Birla Finance Limited (ABFL) offers specialized lending and financing solutions in the areas of Capital Markets, Corporate/ Trade Finance, Commercial Real Estate and Mortgages. Currently ranked within the top 25 NBFCs of India, ABFL has made significant progress and the Company’s balance sheet at INR 15,000 Cr plus exceeds that of several mid\-sized Banks and NBFCs.**
* **The company has a well\-defined vision of being one of the most reputed and material financiers within the lending space – spread across Retail HNI and corporate clientele. It has made significant investments in process and system infrastructure towards preparing for the next level of growth and are one of the only financial entities certified for ISO 9001:2008 across all business processes. Spread across 18 cities, it plans on further diversifying its risk and revenue mix through expansion into new geographies and new product segments allowing customers a one\-window shop for all their financing needs.**
* **Having focused traditionally on secured lending verticals and built a strong balance sheet on the same, ABFL has ventured into Secured Micro Loan Business segment in order to effectively capitalize on its financial base with carefully managed exposures in this higher yield and profit segment.**

**Job Context**


Key Aspects:

* **The Secured Micro Loan Business segment product line caters to funding short term and medium term working capital needs of Small Businesses and individuals, via a suite of customized short and long tenured products, with collateral.**
* **Offerings comprise Secured Micro Loan to self\-employed individuals/ non\-individual entities, with end use of funds (Working capital requirement, business expansion etc.) to be ascertained during the loan appraisal process.**
* **The business is highly retail in nature, characterized by high transaction volumes, smaller ticket sizes, and significantly higher spread and profit margins (up to four times that of Secured Lending products)**
* **Given the Secured Micro Loan nature of loans disbursed, the business also entails stringent controls and monitoring to ensure portfolio health and quality at all times**
* **While unit of sizing up the business is its loan book size, profitability and minimized delinquency are key business objectives.**
* **Higher cost of funding impacts profitability as well as competitiveness of loan rates that can be offered to customers**
* **Understanding of product market characteristics such as connector relationship management, region specific occupations/trade, local financial preferences and practices are important to gain competitive advantage while structuring loans and identifying leads.**
* The AH (Sales) – ABFL is responsible for achieving sales targets as agreed with the Territory Head (Sales) – ABFL, in terms of targeted book size, profitability, growth \& customer service objectives.

 **Key Challenges**

* To deliver on operational the assigned coverage area in a differentiated manner considering local factors, channel dynamics and consumer preferences, that can withstand competitive pressures on the ground
* To grow the business while remaining cognizant of competitive realities in the following areas plan in:
* Market linked product
* Market average IRR \& processing fee levels
* To originate and increase market share in assigned coverage area against stiff competition, overcoming competitive pressures borne out of better established networks, price undercutting, etc.
* To establish a strong local network and leverage the same to generate business leads, and also identify opportunities for cross sell with existing customers
* To constantly upgrade financial \& operational know how of self and team members on efficient loan processing, effective negotiation and relationship building for maintaining credibility and profitable target achievement
* To keep abreast with the latest market trends and local market preferences and needs
* To ensure loan conversion/ sanction/ utilization percentages are high and a broad enough sourcing funnel is built to meet targets
* To ensure credit quality and effective portfolio selection/pre screening thereby minimizing potential NPAs


To ensure compliant sales operations despite sales pressures and market cycles

**Enabling Skill Sets \& Qualifications**

* Critical skill sets required to meet these challenges include business and commercial acumen, team management and communication, execution skills, product\-market understanding, and operations integration \& controlling skills.

**Education \& experience required to fulfil this profile are a graduate with minimum 6 \- 8 yrs of total sales experience in the Banking/ NBFC space, of which at least recent 3 \- 4 yrs experience should be in Micro/affordable loan sales.**

  

4\) Key Result Areas: Write the key results expected from the job and the supporting actions for each of these key result areas (For a majority of jobs typically there could be 4\- 7 key result areas)\- Maximum 10 KRAs can be updated

 **Key Result Areas (****Max 1325 Characters)**

 **Supporting Actions (****Max 1325 Characters)**

  

Branch Sales Planning \& Management

  

* Work with Territory Head (Sales) \- ABFL on devising the branch sales plan and team approach for achieving targets, considering product\-environmental factors, competitive forces and local trends, and cascade the same to the branch team(s)
* Track industry and market developments, scanning the local market and competitive offerings on a periodic basis
* Oversee end to end branch operations and performance, covering all aspects such as sourcing, effectiveness, governance, productivity, channel management, etc.
* Track \& report on sales operations and productivity metrics, and work towards building a high\-performance sales culture
* Manage day\-to\-day branch operations and administration
* Provide data for, compile and review periodic MIS reports for disbursements, profitability, NPAs, market expansion, etc. and communicate to Territory Head (Sales) \- ABFL as well as to team members
  

Customer Acquisition/ Engagement

  

* Identify local business growth opportunities, drive expansion and new customer acquisition initiatives to create a book of targeted size
* Work closely with team members, hand\-holding critical/ complex transactions to ensure favorable closure with customer satisfaction
* Communicate sales targets and provide team members clarity on business goals, role expectations, product characteristics and USPs to enhance effectiveness of sales efforts
* Track cases in the complaint tracker/ escalations received, liaising with relevant stakeholders as required to drive satisfactory closure
* Deploy efforts/ initiatives in consultation with Territory Head (Sales) – ABFL, arising from customer satisfaction survey and resulting NPS (Net Promoter Score), targeting identified focus areas
* Propose and deploy approved solutions and schemes to drive sales and enhance profitability, ensuring dual focus on sales expansion and cost optimization
* Serve as a point of escalation and manage customer complaints/ grievances effectively, intervening especially for key relationships
  

Operational Effectiveness

  

* To drive adoption of efficient business processes/ operations across the Customer Lifecycle (Sourcing, Approval, Servicing, Collections)
* Manage local distribution across channels, interfacing with senior/ critical partners/ stakeholders as required for smooth operations
* Drive process efficiencies and faster TATs through interfacing with stakeholders across processes and functions (Risk, Operations, Sales Governance) and efficient operations
* Drive high performance by reinforcing focus on business and sales growth objectives, effective client engagement, monitoring sales operations and productivity metrics, and providing support and guidance as required
* Drive the implementation of improved processes and best practices in order to enhance operational effectiveness, productivity and overall business impact
  

Cross\-Selling across ABFSG products

  

* Drive activities and initiatives in the team as per Cross\-Selling strategy agreed with Territory Head (Sales) \- ABFL
* Drive alignment to the adopted Cross\-Selling strategy by supporting team members with requisite communications, training, guidance, etc. as required
  

Team and Internal Stakeholder Management

  

* Guide and develop team members for enhanced customer acquisition and engagement efforts, helping them achieve superior performance standards and hand\-holding where required
* Nominate teams for relevant technical and behavioral trainings/ seminars and work on self development initiatives
* Proactively liaise with internal stakeholders for smooth cross\-functional coordination and alignment towards achievement of business objectives.
  

Portfolio \& Risk Management

  

* Work with the Risk, Operations and Sales Governance teams to ensure adherence to risk management and control mechanisms
* Support risk and review process through the credit approval process and by reviewing the loan sanctioning, disbursement process and documentation to ensure controlled operations
* Review financial risk via analysis of city/ branch operations MIS and Data Analytics reports
* Drive compliant Sales Operations and sound risk management via partnership with Risk, Operations and Sales Governance teams, and necessary communication and guidance; drive timely PDD closures and collections
* As part of Relationship Maintenance with institutional customers, review reports on client accounts, business performance, etc. and liaise with Risk while guiding team on delinquency cases
* Train and guide the team for alignment with adopted early alert strategies to reduce NPA risks and losses
* Ensure systematic MIS on NPAs and credit trends, providing inputs on possible risks that could impact portfolio quality

title: Head - Manufacturing, Linen Fabric
description:
Designation: General Manager


Location: India West Bengal JST, Rishra


Organization: Cellulosic Fibre \& Textiles

**Job Description:**
--------------------

#### ***Job Purpose***


To lead and drive the Linen Fabric Operations function by defining and executing operational strategy, and by planning, organizing, and controlling end\-to\-end fabric operations to ensure timely delivery of linen fabrics that meet customer requirements for quality and quantity. The role is accountable for achieving predefined production targets within planned cost and realization parameters, ensuring safe working practices, and optimizing utilization of manpower, materials, and machine resources to deliver consistent operational performance.

#### ***Job Context \& Major Challenges***


Linen is a Labour intensive natural fibre to manufacture and is difficult to maintain consistent quality parameters. It is necessary to source best of the raw materials and to adapt best manufacturing process and systems to maintain the standards.
 There is a scarcity for talents in Indian textile industry to produce this kind of critical fabrics. It is a big challenge for us to search for the talent and to train, develop and retain them.
 We as a premium supplier of Linen, a critical fibre to handle should upgrade ourselves with new technology trends to achieve product excellence at the lowest overall cost.
 Being new suppliers coming into the market, reviewing \& interpreting market expectations and seasonal preferences for developing new product ranges is a big challenge in terms of production without affecting the efficiency or quality of the product as well as the cost effectiveness of production.
 To develop and weave finest count product, to create entry barrier to keep a void between the new entrants in the high potential linen market.
 The Growth plan in fabric production requires technical knowledge with good commercial acumen so as to control the complete supply chain and process effectiveness right from planning of raw materials to delivery of finish fabrics.
 The fabric production which has targeted of 90 Lac Meters in 2015\-16 has further growth expectations of 15% year on year.
 To manage job vendors and to evaluate them periodically to maintain the high standards of the group and take necessary corrective actions as and when required.  

Challenges:* Ensuring best quality
* Cost optimization
* Manpower handling

#### **Key Result Areas**

**Key Result Areas**

  

Supporting Actions

 **Production Planning \& control**

  

* Plan and prioritize the activities of weaving, processing, yarn dyeing and warehouse in coordination with PPC dept
* Identify the area of losses and taking corrective action regularly.
* Analyze, review and control production of fabric to achieve highest production efficiencies including machine utilization.
* Explore new ideas and evaluate them for viability to implement in plant to reduce cycle time, production cost
 **Operations**

  

* Weaving: Ensure smooth Weaving operations (Winding, Warping, Loom shed and Maintenance)
* Dyeing \& Processing: Ensure all activities related to dyeing, preparatory, and finishing section in the dye house and fabric process house within the defined standard of time, quality.
* Ware House: Ensure all activities for the inspection, mending, and packing of fabric in the Finished warehouse, creation of samples, and rejected good reprocessing.
* Process Control: Ensure and monitor all process controls \& parameters, in the fabric processing section. Ensure execution of SOPs for new processes as and when required.
 **Quality**

  

* Analyze and review the quality reports of each section –weaving, processing, yarn dyeing \& packing
* Identify \& eliminate bottle necks in all activities in the Linen Fabric processes.
* Daily Review of quality of final product and direct corrective actions
 **Production Safety and Sustainability**

  

* Maintain Waste Intensity, Energy Intensity, and Water Intensity as per sustainability guidelines
* Implementation of HIRA SOP and maintain good housekeeping \& compliance safe working practices in the plant.
* Ensure Safe Working condition and practices in respective area with zero tolerances.
 **Implementation of WCM and IMS**

  

* Study world’s best manufacturers and compare existing quality system / work practices to analyze the reasons for gaps in quality
* Prepare plan of action, and organize trials for improvement in quality levels
* Direct and monitor the implementation of IMS Quality management norms in the Plant
 **Capability Building**

  

* Motivate and guide team members and create a space for Idea sharing and implementing
* Evaluating performances of sections and Identify training needs for section \& work with HR dept for capability development.
* Groom GET/DET in technical aspects and develop talent pipeline

title: Recruiter
description:
**Company Overview**
--------------------

  

Docusign brings agreements to life. Over 1\.5 million customers and more than a billion people in over 180 countries use Docusign solutions to accelerate the process of doing business and simplify people’s lives. With intelligent agreement management, Docusign unleashes business\-critical data that is trapped inside of documents. Until now, these were disconnected from business systems of record, costing businesses time, money, and opportunity. Using Docusign’s Intelligent Agreement Management platform, companies can create, commit, and manage agreements with solutions created by the \#1 company in e\-signature and contract lifecycle management (CLM).  

  

**What You'll Do**
------------------

  

As a Technical Recruiter, you will be the strategic engine behind our engineering growth. This isn't just about managing a funnel; it’s about acting as a talent advisor to our Engineering leadership, helping them navigate a competitive landscape to find the builders of our future.


You’ll own the full lifecycle—from deep\-dive calibration sessions with Hiring Managers to crafting high\-touch candidate experiences that reflect our culture of innovation. Whether you are hunting for niche Backend experts or scaling our Frontend teams, you’ll use your deep understanding of the tech stack and the talent market to close the best in the business. If you are passionate about the "art of the close" and thrive in a data\-informed, high\-growth environment, we want you on our team

  

This position is an individual contributor role reporting to the TA Manager, India.

 **Responsibility**

* Drive process improvements to help make the hiring process more effective, efficient and positive for both hiring managers and candidates
* Own the full candidate lifecycle for a variety of roles
* Source candidates from relevant networks, online and internal databases, employee referrals and passive candidates through networking and research
* Cultivate strong partnerships with hiring managers and key collaborators, providing strategic guidance on talent acquisition and workforce planning
* Collaborate with the wider HR team to enhance recruitment processes, ensuring efficiency, consistency, and a positive candidate experience
* Utilise market insights to tailor recruitment strategies, ensuring our approach remains competitive and aligned with the evolving needs of our organisation
* Track and report on key recruitment metrics, including time\-to\-fill, pass through rates \& offer acceptance rates

  

  

**Job Designation**
-------------------

 **Hybrid:**


Employee divides their time between in\-office and remote work. Access to an office location is required. (Frequency: Minimum 2 days per week; may vary by team but will be weekly in\-office expectation)  

Positions at Docusign are assigned a job designation of either In Office, Hybrid or Remote and are specific to the role/job. Preferred job designations are not guaranteed when changing positions within Docusign. Docusign reserves the right to change a position's job designation depending on business needs and as permitted by local law.

  

  

**What You Bring**
------------------

 **Basic**

* 5\+ years of full\-lifecycle recruiting experience, with at least 3 years dedicated specifically to core technical roles (e.g., Backend, Frontend, Mobile, DevOps, or Data Engineering)
* Experience in partnering with Engineering leadership to define technical candidate personas, calibrate search parameters, and drive strategic alignment throughout the hiring lifecycle
* Hands\-on experience with Enterprise Applicant Tracking Systems (e.g.,Smart recruiters Greenhouse, Lever, iCIMS, or Workday)
* Proven track record of sourcing passive technical talent using LinkedIn Recruiter, GitHub, Stack Overflow, and X\-ray search string
* Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field (or equivalent professional experience)

 **Preferred**

* Experience recruiting for high\-growth product companies or top\-tier tech firms.
* Ability to use recruiting metrics (e.g., pass\-through rates, time\-to\-fill, and source\-of\-hire) to influence hiring decisions and forecast pipeline needs.
* Proven ability to enhance the recruitment lifecycle by optimizing interview loops, elevating the candidate experience, and implementing scalable process improvements to drive hiring efficiency.
* Expertise in local and global tech talent markets, with a proven ability to translate market intelligence, salary benchmarks, and competitor mapping into actionable hiring strategies

  

  

**Life At Docusign**
--------------------

 **Working here**


Docusign is committed to building trust and making the world more agreeable for our employees, customers and the communities in which we live and work. You can count on us to listen, be honest, and try our best to do what’s right, every day. At Docusign, everything is equal.  

We each have a responsibility to ensure every team member has an equal opportunity to succeed, to be heard, to exchange ideas openly, to build lasting relationships, and to do the work of their life. Best of all, you will be able to feel deep pride in the work you do, because your contribution helps us make the world better than we found it. And for that, you’ll be loved by us, our customers, and the world in which we live. **Accommodation**


Docusign is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities in our job application procedures. If you need such an accommodation, or a religious accommodation, during the application process, please contact us at accommodations@docusign.com.  

If you experience any issues, concerns, or technical difficulties during the application process please get in touch with our Talent organization at taops@docusign.com for assistance.
  
### **Our global benefits**


#### **Paid time off**


Take time to unwind with earned days off, plus paid company holidays based on your region.
#### **Paid parental leave**


Take up to six months off with your child after birth, adoption or foster care placement.
#### **Full health benefits**


Options for 100% employer\-paid health plans from day one of employment.
#### **Retirement plans**


Select retirement and pension programs with potential for employer contributions.
#### **Learning \& development**


Grow your career with coaching, online courses and education reimbursements.
#### **Compassionate care leave**


Paid time off following the loss of a loved one and other life\-changing events.

We are Elaterz, a lean and ambitious digital marketing agency focused on driving tangible results and growth for our clients. As a startup, we're building a brand known for innovation, speed, and execution.

To support our growth, we are looking for a **dynamic and people\-first HR Manager** who can build strong internal systems, shape company culture, and help us scale a high\-performance remote team. If you thrive in a fast\-paced startup environment and want to take ownership of people operations, this is your opportunity.

**Unique Perk: Strategic Work \& Travel Tours**

We believe in fostering deep collaboration beyond screens. For the right candidate, you will have the opportunity to join our Founder/Core Team on occasional work trips and strategic tours (both domestic and potentially international).

These tours include:

* Intensive hiring \& culture\-building sessions
* Team bonding \& leadership alignment
* Employer branding \& content creation

All accommodation and necessary travel expenses are covered. *(Participation is encouraged but optional.)*

**The Role: HR Manager**

You will be responsible for building, managing, and scaling Elaterz’s human resources function. From hiring top talent to developing company culture, you will play a key role in shaping the future of our organization.

**Key Responsibilities:Talent Acquisition \& Hiring**

* Lead end\-to\-end recruitment processes (sourcing, screening, interviewing, onboarding)
* Develop hiring strategies to attract top remote talent
* Build and maintain a strong employer brand

**HR Strategy \& Operations**

* Design and implement HR policies, SOPs, and processes
* Manage employee lifecycle from onboarding to exit
* Ensure compliance with relevant labor laws and regulations

**Culture \& Engagement**

* Build a strong, positive remote work culture
* Plan employee engagement activities and team initiatives
* Act as a bridge between management and team members

**Performance Management**

* Develop KPI systems and performance evaluation frameworks
* Conduct regular performance reviews and feedback cycles
* Support managers in team development and productivity

**Learning \& Development**

* Identify skill gaps and organize training programs
* Build leadership pipelines within the company

**What We're Looking For:**

* **Experience:** 2–5 years in HR, preferably in startups, agencies, or remote teams
* **Recruitment Expertise:** Proven ability to hire quality talent across roles
* **Startup Mindset:** Proactive, adaptable, and comfortable building systems from scratch
* **Communication Skills:** Strong interpersonal and conflict\-resolution abilities
* **Ownership Mentality:** Ability to independently manage and improve HR processes
* **Tech\-Savvy:** Familiarity with HR tools, ATS systems, and remote collaboration tools

**Why Join Elaterz?**  
**Ownership \& Impact**

You will shape the people and culture of the company from the ground up.

**Flexibility**

Work from anywhere with a fully remote setup.

**Unique Experience**

Opportunity to join paid team work\-tours and collaborate closely with leadership.

**Growth Opportunity**

Be a core member of a fast\-growing agency with leadership potential.

**Ready to Build a Winning Team with Us?**

Apply now with your resume and a brief note on your experience in hiring and managing remote teams.

**Job Description:**


We are looking for a skilled HR manager to oversee all aspects of Human Resources practices and processes. You will support business needs and ensure the proper implementation of company strategy and objectives. The goal is to promote corporate values and enable business success through human resources management, including job design, recruitment, performance management, training \& development, employment cycle changes, talent management, and facilities management services.

* Supports organization staff by establishing and interviewing program; counselling managers on candidate selection; conducting and analyzing exit interviews; and recommending changes.
* Prepares employees for assignments by establishing and conducting orientation and training programs.
* Manages a pay plan by conducting periodic pay surveys; scheduling and conducting job evaluations; preparing pay budgets; monitoring and scheduling individual pay actions; and recommending, planning, and implementing pay structure revisions.

* Implements employee benefits programs and informs employees of benefits by studying and assessing benefit needs and trends; recommending benefit programs to management; directing the processing of benefit claims; obtaining and evaluating benefit contract bids; awarding benefit contracts; and designing and conducting educational programs on benefit programs.
* Ensures legal compliance by monitoring and implementing applicable human resource federal and state requirements, conducting investigations, maintaining records, and representing the organization at hearings.

The ideal candidate combines strong JavaScript expertise with deep familiarity of the advertising industry, high emotional intelligence, and proven experience in cross\-regional collaboration. * Communicate effectively with non\-technical stakeholders (creative, marketing, client teams) using high emotional intelligence, translating technical concepts into clear, actionable feedback and aligning on expectations.
* Stay updated with emerging front\-end technologies, ad creative trends, and industry best practices to continuously improve creative development processes and deliver innovative ad solutions.

* Strong proficiency in JavaScript (ES6\+), HTML5, CSS3, and front\-end frameworks/libraries relevant to ad creative (e.g., React, Vue.js, GreenSock GSAP for animations).
* Deep familiarity with the advertising industry, including ad formats (banner ads, interstitial ads, native ads, video ads), programmatic advertising workflows, and IAB standards.
* Proven experience in cross\-regional collaboration, working with global or distributed teams to deliver projects on time and align on creative and technical requirements.

### **Job Description**

  

  

**Channel Partnerships Manager**
--------------------------------

 *Own and scale college and university partnerships to drive on\-ground activations, lead generation, and enrolments for Kraftshala’s placement\-oriented programs.*

### **The Short Version**

 **Who we’re looking for:** We’re looking for a Channel Partnerships Manager who thrives in high\-ownership, on\-ground roles and already has existing relationships with colleges, universities, and training institutes. This is a zero\-fluff role for someone who enjoys opening doors, building partnerships from scratch, and driving real enrolment outcomes.

  

You should be comfortable operating independently, travelling frequently, and engaging senior stakeholders like TPOs, deans, and faculty to create win\-win collaborations.

 **What the role is about:** You’ll build and scale Kraftshala’s offline acquisition engine by forming partnerships with colleges and institutes across India, starting with Delhi NCR. Your work will directly influence lead flow, enrolments, and revenue, making this a **core growth role** \- not a support function.

 **Why you should apply:**

* Opportunity to build a partnerships channel from scratch and scale it nationally
* Clear linkage between your work and enrolment/revenue outcomes
* Direct exposure to senior leadership on GTM decisions

 **About us:** Kraftshala is India’s largest higher\-education institution in terms of marketing placements, with a 94% placement rates, and we are gunning to become the world’s largest career launchpad, across domains.

  

We’re backed by a number of eminent investors including ex\-unicorn startup founders and CXOs of global giants like RedBus, NoBroker, Nestlé, and Performics.

### **The Detailed Version**

  

The Channel Partnerships Manager will own on\-ground partnerships with colleges, universities, and training institutes to drive awareness and enrolments for Kraftshala’s placement\-oriented programs. This is a field\-heavy, individual contributor role requiring frequent travel, strong stakeholder management, and sharp execution.

  

While the initial focus will be Delhi NCR, deployment will be opportunity\-led with pan\-India scope over time.

  

Specific Responsibilities \& Metrics:

* Build and manage institutional partnerships**.** *Metrics to measure: Number of active college/institute partnerships; depth of engagement per partner; repeat collaborations*
* Plan and execute on\-ground seminars, workshops, and events.*Metrics to measure: Number of events conducted; attendance quality; lead yield per event*
* Generate and hand over qualified leads to the Admissions team**.** *Metrics to measure: Leads generated; lead qualification rate; successful handover and follow\-through*
* Own relationships with TPOs, deans, and faculty stakeholders**.** *Metrics to measure: Stakeholder responsiveness; partnership longevity; referral introductions*
* Track performance and pipeline using CRM tools**.** *Metrics to measure: CRM hygiene; reporting accuracy; visibility of funnel and outcomes*

### **Monthly Outcomes**

  

Month 1:

* Onboard fully on Kraftshala’s programs, value proposition, and admissions funnel
* Activate existing college/institute contacts
* Close initial partnerships and execute early seminars/events

  

Month 2:

* Build a predictable cadence of events and partnerships
* Improve lead quality and handover effectiveness
* Identify high\-performing partner profiles and formats

  

Month 3\+:

* Scale partnerships across new geographies based on opportunity
* Drive consistent contribution to enrolments and revenue
* Act as a feedback loop to leadership on on\-ground GTM insights

### **Top Grading**

* **Ownership \& Accountability:** An A\-player independently builds and scales partnerships end\-to\-end, whereas a B\-player waits for direction and external momentum.
* **Stakeholder Influence:** An A\-player earns trust with senior academic stakeholders and creates repeat collaborations, whereas a B\-player struggles to move beyond transactional conversations.
* **Execution Excellence:** An A\-player consistently converts on\-ground activity into qualified leads, whereas a B\-player confuses effort with outcomes.
* **Data Discipline:** An A\-player maintains clean CRM data and clear reporting, whereas a B\-player treats tracking as an afterthought.

### **Must Haves:**

* 2 \- 3 years of experience in B2B business development, preferably in the education or edtech sector with prior exposure to college/institute partnerships. *(We are not too fussed about the number of years. Experience is simply a proxy for capability, which is what we really care for).*
* Prior experience engaging with TPOs, deans, and faculty members
* Existing college or university relationships that can be activated immediately
* Comfortable with field\-heavy roles and frequent intercity travel
* Proven ability to generate, track, and hand over qualified leads
* Working knowledge of CRM tools and outcome reporting

### **Selection Process:**

  

As a small team, we must get to know each other before taking the leap. We want to ensure you succeed in your role within our team. Each conversation with us will last about 30\-60 minutes. Typically the whole process takes between 10 \- 15 business days depending on your and our schedules.

* **Conversation 1:** This will be a call with the HR Team to understand your profile briefly and share the details of the selection process.
* **Technical Exercise:** This is a specific assessment designed to evaluate your fit for this role
* **Conversation 2**: This will be with our Head of Admissions wherein you can expect to be evaluated on the competencies needed for the job (mentioned above).
* **Conversation 3**:A conversation with our CEO to ensure that there is a fit with the Kraftshala Kode.
* **Extending an offer**: If all goes well, we will extend an offer that will mention the relevant details.

### **Location:**

  

Delhi

description:
**About Us:**


We love going to work and think you should too. Our team is dedicated to trust, customer obsession, agility, and striving to be better everyday. These values serve as the foundation of our culture, guiding our actions and driving us towards excellence. We foster a culture of performance and recognition, allowing us to transform growth as we enable our employees to do the best work of their careers.


**This position is located in Pune.** You'll be working in a major tech center of Pune, India. Across the globe, our Centers of Energy serve as hubs where we accelerate productivity and collaboration, inspire creativity, and cultivate a culture of connection and celebration. Our teams coordinate their time in Centers of Energy to reflect how they work best.



To learn more about life at LogicMonitor, check out our Careers Page.


**What You'll Do:**



LogicMonitor is disrupting the observability market and changing the way businesses take disparate sources of data and turn it into action. We are already a leader in this space \- and we started by solving the hardest, most complicated problem first. With roots in the IT Infrastructure Monitoring space, we are on an evolutionary journey heading toward what's next \- unified observability. Our platform enables enterprise resiliency through data insights from the infrastructure, network, and application. As we enter this next phase of growth, we are in search of a Sr. Talent Acquisition Specialist.



In this vital position, you will have ownership of full lifecycle recruiting which includes: sourcing passive candidates, screening active candidates, advising and coaching hiring managers, coordinating interviews for success and offer negotiation. You will also act as a consultant and business partner for all recruiting\-related activities, working collaboratively with all levels within the organization. You'll be seen as a subject matter expert for recruiting best practices and LogicMonitor policies, and champion our processes while providing a positive experience for managers and candidates.



In this senior level, you'll also have the opportunity to mentor junior recruiters, and coach and train team members on best practices.



**Here's a closer look at this key role:**

  

* Responsible for full life\-cycle recruiting activities for assigned requisitions including sourcing, resume review, interviewing and offer negotiation
* Serve as a talent partner for assigned requisitions, collaborating with all levels within the organization
* Serve as an advisor to hiring managers \- coaching them on recruiting processes and best practices, guiding decisions, and solving complex problems while aligning managers to our process and policies
* Develop and implement creative approaches to uncover new or specific sources of talent, utilizing advanced recruitment sourcing techniques; experiment and try different approaches for difficult reqs where normal practices are not yielding results
* Provide candidates with a best\-in\-class positive candidate experience; providing timely interviews, communications, and updates in a voice that balance business needs, recruiting best practices, and the desire to leave candidates with a positive impression of LogicMonitor
* Mentor junior recruiters on best practices, while creating an open and encouraging environment for growth; find opportunities to provide training and coaching to the talent team
* Ensure compliance with legal and regulatory requirements and internal policies, using best judgement in ambiguous situations and escalating to leadership when needed
* Participate in team projects and initiatives as assigned
* Meet or exceed performance metrics

**What You'll Need:**
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience
* 5\+ years' professional recruiting experience
* Ability to work in a fast\-paced, complex environment and operate with agility in ambiguous situations
* Ability to work collaboratively with team members to ensure results, mentoring junior recruiters while creating an open and encouraging environment for growth
* Well versed with Sourcing Methodologies: Boolean Search, X\-Ray Search, Passive Search, Linkedin Recruiting, other creative methods of sourcing for passive talent
* Metrics and results driven; able to adhere to processes and guide managers on hiring practices
* Proven success influencing teams and stakeholders to achieve a goal while following LogicMonitor hiring practices
* Proven ability to function with a high level of independence: able to independently research and investigate answers to problems using available resources, utilizing documentation to guide on process complexities
* Excellent time/priority management skills; Ability to adjust to multiple demands and constantly shifting priorities under tight deadlines and time constraints
* Sound judgement and decision making skills; Strong problem\-solving ability in order to identify and solve issues when they arise, proposing options or a solution while understanding all stakeholders involved and downstream effects
* Critical thinking skills \- ability to deep dive into details and solving problems while understanding the bigger picture and alignment to business objectives
* Ability to strategically adapt communications to hiring managers, leadership, and candidates while balancing a positive experience, process adherence, and business alignment

description:
**roduction \& Packing Executive (Machine Operator Role)**

**Location:** Ashok Nagar, Central Bangalore (Work from Office)

**About IncredaBrew**

Healthelicious Foods runs **IncredaBrew**, a fast\-growing coffee brand focused on delivering a better daily coffee experience. Founded by a coffee farmer’s son and an IIM\-Ahmedabad alumnus, our products are among the top\-performing in our category on Amazon, and we operate from a central Bangalore facility.

Website: https://www.incredabrew.com  
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/incredabrew\_coffee/

**About the Role**

This is a **hands\-on production role** involving **operating coffee packing machines, packing products, and managing dispatch**.

**This is NOT a desk\-based job.**  
You will work on the production floor and be actively involved in daily packing and fulfilment.

This role is best suited for individuals who are comfortable with **physical work, repetition, and maintaining high accuracy and hygiene standards**.

**Key Responsibilities**

Production \& Machine Operation (Primary)

* Operate coffee packing machines (training will be provided)
* Learn and handle basic machine setup, adjustments, and troubleshooting
* Fill, seal, and pack coffee sachets and jars as per quality standards
* Maintain cleanliness and hygiene of the machine and work area

Packing \& Dispatch (Secondary)

* Pack and label customer orders accurately
* Prepare shipments for dispatch
* Ensure all orders are fulfilled on time

Inventory \& Warehouse Support

* Assist in stock counting and inventory tracking
* Handle storage, receiving, and movement of materials

**Who This Role Is For**

* Comfortable with **hands\-on work and working on the production floor**
* Okay with **repetitive tasks for long periods**
* Detail\-oriented and takes pride in doing accurate work
* Reliable, disciplined, and consistent in attendance
* Willing to learn and grow in a fast\-moving environment

**Who This Role Is NOT For**

❌ Candidates looking for desk\-based / office\-only roles  
❌ Candidates not comfortable with physical or hands\-on work  
❌ Candidates only interested in coordination or computer\-based tasks

**Requirements**

* Minimum education: 10th pass
* Freshers are welcome
* Prior experience in packing, warehouse, or factory work is a plus (not mandatory)
* Must be based in Bangalore
* Willingness to learn basic computer/mobile\-based tasks for simple tracking and coordination
* ITI diploma (mechanical/electrical) or machine experience is a plus (not mandatory)
* Ability to understand basic English for reading and adjusting machine settings

**Compensation \& Working Details**

* **Salary:** **₹20,000/month**
* ₹18,000 fixed
* ₹2,000 performance\-based variable

*(Most of the incentive is designed to be easy to earn with consistent, disciplined work. It is based on timeliness, cleanliness of machine/workstation, and packing accuracy.)*

* **Annual Bonus:** **₹30,000** (fixed, paid on completion of 12 months)
* **Working Days:**
* Monday to Friday: 9:30 am – 6:30 pm
* Saturday: 9:30 am – 2:30 pm (half day)
* **Location:** Ashok Nagar, Bangalore (in\-person role)

**Growth Opportunity**

High\-performing candidates can grow into roles in:

* Inventory management
* Production planning
* Operations

**Why Join Us**

* Be part of a **fast\-growing consumer brand**
* Work closely with the founding team
* Learn real production and operations from the ground up
* Stable, long\-term role with clear growth potential

Job Types: Full\-time, Permanent, Fresher

System Administrator responsible for managing, maintaining, and supporting the organization’s IT infrastructure, including servers, networks, and user systems. Ensures system availability, security, and smooth day\-to\-day IT operations.


**Key Responsibilities**


* Install, configure, and maintain servers, desktops, and laptops
* Manage user accounts, access controls, and permissions
* Monitor system performance and ensure high availability
* Handle network configuration including LAN, WAN, Wi\-Fi, and VPN
* Troubleshoot hardware, software, and network\-related issues
* Perform regular system updates, patches, and backups
* Ensure data security, antivirus management, and firewall configuration
* Maintain email systems and related services
* Support employees with IT\-related issues (remote and onsite)
* Manage IT assets, inventory, and documentation
* Coordinate with vendors for hardware, software, and AMC (Annual Maintenance Contract)
* Implement and maintain IT policies and procedures
* Ensure proper backup and disaster recovery processes
* Maintain logs of system activities and incidents


**Required Skills**


* Strong knowledge of Windows/Linux operating systems
* Understanding of networking concepts (IP, DNS, DHCP, VPN)
* Experience with server management and virtualization
* Familiarity with firewall and security systems
* Knowledge of backup solutions and data recovery
* Basic understanding of cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, etc.)
* Good troubleshooting and problem\-solving skills
* Strong communication and user support skills


**Educational Qualification**


* Bachelor’s Degree in IT, Computer Science, or related field


**Experience**


* 0\-2 years of experience in system administration or IT support (Freshers can apply)


**Other Requirements**


* Ability to handle multiple systems and users efficiently
* Willingness to provide support beyond working hours if required
* Good documentation and reporting skills


**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**


* System uptime and availability
* Issue resolution time
* Security incident management
* User satisfaction
* Backup and recovery success rate

**Location:** Hinjawadi, Pune, Maharashtra  
**Employment Type:** Full time \| On\-site

**Job Description:** Business Development Executive (BDE) is an entry level position in sales and marketing career with DLIFE Interiors. Initial assignment is into creating a productive network of referral partners within the given branch area. Task is to enroll potential referral partners (Silver Envoys) and maintain strong relationships with them and generate enquiries (leads) for home interiors. This role does not involve sales, but requires extensive travel within a 30 KM radius of the branch and meeting potential referral partners and enrolling them to the Silver Envoy Programme. Parallely, the BDE starts learning the sales process, acquires knowledge in the interior industry and develops the necessary skills to become an assistant or support client manager in the same or another branch. It is more of a sales promotional and supportive role, in the journey towards becoming a successful client manager.

 Sales/ Interpersonal Skills: Ability to meet, convince and convert partners and potential customers for mutual benefit.  
 Networking and relationship building: Success in this field depends upon the ability to build productive, long term relationships.  
 Work Ethics: Self\-motivated, goal oriented and disciplined to work with minimum supervision.  
 Reporting: Maintain and share the details about the new Silver Envoys and leads to the Silver Envoy Manager as well as the branch manager.

**Training:**  
 The first 10 working days will be dedicated to formal training and showroom visits.  
 From the 11th working day onwards, they will begin outdoor visits for Silver Envoy creation and lead generation.

**Target:**  
 The target for Silver Envoy enrolment \-Enroll 3 Silver Envoys (Potential referral partners) a day.  
 Generate one potential lead per day.

**Future Career Progression:** BDE → Support Client Manager → Assistant Client Manager → Client Manager → Branch Manager → Area Sales Manager

**Incentives:** BDE Incentives are linked to the successful closing of the BDE generated leads by a client manager in the branch.

title: Shopify Performance & Speed Optimization Developer
description:
**Job Summary**

We are hiring a **Shopify Performance Specialist** to optimize our ecommerce website for speed, efficiency, and scalability.

The primary goal is to reduce website load time to **under 2–2\.5 seconds (mobile\-first)** while maintaining or improving conversion performance.

**Key ResponsibilitiesWebsite Speed Optimization**

* Improve Core Web Vitals including LCP, TBT, and CLS
* Reduce overall page load time across mobile and desktop
* Identify and fix render\-blocking resources
* Optimize Time to Interactive (TTI)

**App \& Script Optimization**

* Audit all installed Shopify apps
* Remove unnecessary or redundant apps
* Clean leftover code from uninstalled apps
* Defer or delay non\-critical JavaScript
* Eliminate duplicate tracking scripts (Meta, Google Ads, etc.)

**Theme Optimization**

* Optimize or rebuild theme using **Shopify Dawn or similar lightweight theme**
* Reduce DOM size and unnecessary homepage sections
* Optimize Liquid code and frontend structure

**Image \& Asset Optimization**

* Compress and optimize images (WebP where applicable)
* Implement proper lazy loading
* Optimize fonts and remove unused assets

**Performance Testing \& Debugging**

* Use tools like GTmetrix, PageSpeed Insights, and Lighthouse
* Analyze waterfall reports and identify bottlenecks
* Ensure consistent performance across devices

**Performance Goals (KPIs)Primary Targets**

* Load Time: Under 2\.5 seconds (mobile), target under 2 seconds
* Largest Contentful Paint (LCP): Under 2\.5 seconds
* Total Blocking Time (TBT): Under 300 ms
* Cumulative Layout Shift (CLS): Under 0\.1

**Technical Targets**

* Reduce total requests to under 120
* Reduce page size to under 2\.5 MB

**Business Requirements**

* No negative impact on conversion rate
* No checkout or tracking issues

**Project Timeline**

**Week 1:**

* Full audit of apps, scripts, and theme
* Remove unnecessary apps and code
* Establish baseline performance

**Week 2:**

* Theme optimization or migration
* Homepage and structure cleanup

**Week 3:**

* Advanced optimization including script deferring and lazy loading

**Week 4:**

* Testing, debugging, and final performance improvements
* Final performance report

**Required Skills**

* Strong experience with Shopify (Liquid, themes, architecture)
* Proven experience improving website speed and Core Web Vitals
* JavaScript performance optimization
* Experience reducing app and script bloat
* Familiarity with GTmetrix, PageSpeed Insights, or Lighthouse

**Required Qualifications**

* 2–5 years of hands\-on experience working with Shopify stores
* Strong expertise in Shopify Liquid, theme architecture, and frontend structure
* Proven experience improving website speed and Core Web Vitals (LCP, TBT, CLS)
* Experience reducing page load time, total requests, and JavaScript execution
* Strong understanding of JavaScript, HTML, and CSS performance optimization
* Experience auditing and removing app/script bloat on Shopify stores
* Familiarity with tools like GTmetrix, Google PageSpeed Insights, and Lighthouse
* Ability to analyze waterfall reports and identify performance bottlenecks

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Prior experience optimizing high\-traffic ecommerce websites
* Understanding of conversion rate optimization (CRO)
* Experience with Meta Pixel, Google Ads, and tracking implementations
* Experience working with lightweight themes like Shopify Dawn
* Ability to balance performance improvements without impacting UX or conversions

**What We Value More Than Degrees**

* Demonstrated **before vs after performance improvements**
* Ability to explain **how and why performance improved**
* Practical experience solving real Shopify speed issues
* Clean, structured approach to debugging and optimization

**Important Notes**

* Freshers \& Candidates relying on “speed optimization apps” will not be considered
* Must have real examples of performance improvements

**How to Apply**

Please include the following:

* Links to Shopify stores you have optimized
* Link for before and after performance results
* Brief explanation of your approach to improving website speed

Pay: ₹20,000\.00 \- ₹30,000\.00 per month

Application Question(s):

* Links where we can see your before and after performance results
* Brief explanation of your approach to improving website speed

title: HR Interns
description:
Role Overview
   

  

 We are seeking a detail\-oriented and proactive HR Intern with a strong interest in Indian Labour Law and Compliance Implementation. In this role, you will help bridge the gap between statutory requirements and daily HR operations. You will support the HR department in auditing existing practices, drafting compliant policies, and ensuring our organization adheres to the latest Central and State\-specific labor regulations in India.
   

  

 This is an ideal opportunity for a student or recent graduate pursuing an MBA in HR, a Master’s in Labour Studies (MLS), or a Bachelor of Laws (LLB) to gain hands\-on experience in a corporate compliance environment.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Statutory Research \& Monitoring


 Conduct research on the four new Labour Codes (Wage, Social Security, Industrial Relations, and Occupational Safety) and their phased implementation.
   

  

 Track updates regarding state\-specific Shops and Establishments Acts and Professional Tax requirements.
   

  

 Assist in mapping Central and State\-specific compliance requirements to internal HR processes.
   

  

* Policy Drafting \& Indian Compliance


 Assist in updating the Employee Handbook to ensure compliance with the Standing Orders Act and local leave policies.
   

  

 Support the POSH (Prevention of Sexual Harassment) Committee with administrative tasks, awareness posters, and documentation of training sessions.
   

  

 Draft Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) for grievance redressal as per the Industrial Disputes Act.
   

  

* Compliance Auditing \& Payroll Support


 Perform audits of employee files to ensure mandatory documentation (Aadhaar, UAN, PAN, nomination forms) is complete.
   

  

 Review job descriptions to ensure alignment with Code on Wages definitions (e.g., distinguishing between 'Worker' and 'Employee' categories).
   

  

 Assist with "Statutory Health Checks" including EPF, ESI, and Gratuity record\-keeping.
   

  

* Training \& Education


 Help design internal training materials for managers on the POSH Act and the Maternity Benefit Act.
   

  

 Prepare FAQs on Indian tax deductions (TDS) and social security benefits to help employees understand their pay slips.
   

  

* Employee Relations \& Onboarding


 Support the HR team in drafting offer letters and employment contracts that comply with the latest Indian judicial precedents.
   

  

 Ensure all exit formalities align with statutory requirements for full and final (F\&F) settlements.
   

  

**Requirements \& Qualifications**
 Education: Currently pursuing or recently completed an MBA (HR), Master of Labour Studies (MLS), or LLB.
   

  

 Legal Literacy: Foundational knowledge of Indian Labour Laws (e.g., Factories Act, EPF Act, ESI Act, POSH Act, and Payment of Bonus Act).
   

  

 Attention to Detail: High level of precision in reviewing statutory registers and employee records.
   

  

 Confidentiality: Absolute discretion in handling sensitive employee data and PII (Personally Identifiable Information).
   

  

 Communication: Strong writing skills in English; proficiency in Hindi or other regional languages is an added advantage for interpreting local state rules.
   

  

 Learning Objectives
   

  

 By the end of this internship, the candidate will have:
   

  

 Developed a practical understanding of how Indian Labour Laws translate into corporate policy.
   

  

 Gained experience in risk mitigation, statutory filing processes, and HR auditing.
   

  

 Built a portfolio of drafted policies and compliance communication materials.
   

  

 Learned the complexities of managing compliance across different Indian states.

title: Hardware Maintenance Engineer
description:
**Engineer – Remote Accessibility \& PSES System Maintenance (SYNC3000 / SYNC2000, KPTCL Project)**  
**Location:** Bengaluru / Field Sites across Karnataka (KPTCL Substations)

**Role Overview:**  
The Junior Engineer will support the operation and maintenance of the Remote Accessibility System (Automatic Disturbance Record Collection System) deployed across 144 substations under the KPTCL network. The system integrates SYNC3000 / SYNC2000 devices with protection relays, industrial network switches, and a Linux\-based Control Centre running PSES (Power Station Enterprise Suite). This platform enables centralized monitoring, disturbance record collection, and relay configuration management.

The role involves assisting in monitoring system performance, supporting field maintenance activities, and troubleshooting communication issues between substations and the control centre. The engineer will coordinate with field teams and central monitoring personnel to ensure reliable data acquisition and system availability.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Perform preventive and corrective maintenance of SYNC3000 / SYNC2000 systems installed in substations.
* Monitor communication links between protection relays, network switches, and control centre servers.
* Assist in operating and supporting the Linux\-based PSES control centre for disturbance record data collection.
* Identify and resolve connectivity or configuration issues in coordination with field engineers and support teams.
* Maintain records of relay firmware versions, configuration tools, and disturbance record logs.
* Support periodic system checks, updates, and documentation to ensure system reliability.

**Qualifications:**

* B.E. / B.Tech. in Electrical, Electronics, or Communication Engineering.
* 0–1 year of experience; fresh graduates are encouraged to apply.
* Basic understanding of protection relays, IP networking, and Linux systems.
* Good documentation, analytical, and coordination skills.
* Willingness to travel to substations across Karnataka.

**Growth Opportunity:**  
This position provides practical exposure to substation automation systems, IEC 61850 communication, disturbance record analysis, and enterprise\-level power automation platforms, supporting career growth in SCADA and power system integration.

description:

 At Barry\-Wehmiller Companies, we believe business can be a powerful force for good. Headquartered in St. Louis, Missouri, we are a global leader in manufacturing technology and services. Since our founding in 1885 as a maker of brewing machinery, we’ve grown through the acquisition of more than 80 companies, serving industries such as packaging, paper converting, sheeting, corrugating, engineering, and IT consulting. In 2016, we ranked No. 10 on the

 In India, Barry\-Wehmiller operates as a hub of innovation and collaboration through our Global Competency Center (GCC) and other strategic functions. The GCC houses centers of excellence in engineering, content management, sourcing, software development, global IT operations, and shared financial services—providing critical support to Barry\-Wehmiller divisions worldwide.
   

  

 Our culture is built on:
   

  

* Ownership – Drive features end\-to\-end, from design to deployment.
* Flexibility – A friendly, results\-oriented environment that respects your time.
* Empowerment – Your ideas matter, and your work creates visible impact.
* Learning and Growth – Tackle complex challenges alongside passionate peers, with continuous support for your development.


**Career Development and Global Exposure**
 At Barry\-Wehmiller, your growth is our priority. You’ll have access to world\-class learning programs, leadership development opportunities, and mentorship from industry experts. Our global footprint means you’ll collaborate with teams across continents, gaining exposure to diverse markets, cutting\-edge technologies, and best practices from around the world. Whether you aspire to deepen your technical expertise or take on leadership roles, we provide the resources and support to help you thrive.
   

  

 If you’re ready to bring your best thinking to a high\-impact, future\-focused environment—where long\-term stability meets start\-up agility—and be part of a company that cares deeply about people, we’d love to hear from you.
   

  

**About The Role**
 In this role, you will be focused on monitoring, managing and maintaining the Barry\-Wehmiller global network. You'll work closely with engineering teams and with various vendors and partners (including hardware vendors, local IT support, Datacenter and network providers, and ISPs) to maintain and improve our global infrastructure. This role ensures the maximum uptime performance, and security of critical systems and services. This is a highly visible position that requires deep technical understanding of enterprise networks infrastructure, networking (physical), and basic experience with data analysis.
   

  

 To be successful in this position, you should have excellent technical skills, communication skills, and be able to navigate a range of challenges and constraints (e.g. schedule adherence, time zones, and cultures).
   

  

**Who You Are**
 You are detail\-oriented, eager to learn, and excited to grow your career in a fast\-paced, global infrastructure environment. You bring foundational knowledge of enterprise networks, datacentre environments, networking, and Linux systems, and are motivated to support mission\-critical operations. You’re comfortable following established processes, working across time zones, and collaborating with global teams. You will be working with partners to support infrastructure to a number of remote locations. You will have had experience managing operational environments and used to developing new approaches to improve efficiency or operational stability.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities:**
* Monitor, analyze, and maintain global SD\-WAN infrastructure \& enterprise networks using NOC monitoring tools (e.g., SolarWinds, PRTG, Zabbix \& Meraki Dashboard)
* Respond to network incidents and performance degradations, performing L2 troubleshooting across SD\-WAN, LAN, WAN, VOIP, Perimeter and VPN environments.
* Coordinate with carriers, vendors, and internal network engineering teams for incident escalation and resolution.
* Perform proactive link performance analysis, identify chronic network issues, and contribute to continuous improvement initiatives.
* Maintain network documentation, topology diagrams, and operational runbooks.
* Participate in on\-call rotations and provide 24x7 support coverage as part of the NOC operations model.
* Support and optimize routing policies (BGP, OSPF) and QoS configurations to ensure traffic prioritization and SLA adherence.
* Generate performance and availability reports and contribute to incident trend analysis and problem management reviews.


**Technical Skills**
* 5\+ years of experience with event logging \& network monitoring tools such as SolarWinds, Zabbix, PRTG \& Splunk.
* 3\+ years of experience with SD\-WAN solutions (Meraki, Viptela, Versa etc)
* 2\+ years of experience with Meraki appliances (MX, MS)
* Experience with any one of CSPs (Azure , AWS or GCP)
* Deep understanding of the OSI model \& Solid knowledge of TCP/IP
* Experience with packet captures and analysis with Wireshark.
* Key skills for L2 protocols are Spanning Tree modes PVST\+, RSTP, LACP, 802\.1q, VTP, VLAN, ARP \& EtherChannel
* Key skills for L3 network protocols are EIGRP, OSPF \& BGP
* Experience with IPSec, IPAM, DHCP, DNS and authentication such as Radius/TACACS.
* General networking and security troubleshooting (Firewalls, Load Balancers, Proxies, Routing \& Switching)
* Experience with one of Cisco FTD, Palo Alto or Fortinet Firewalls.
* Basic Scripting and development skills with knowledge\& understanding of regular expressions, APIs \&webhooks.
* Familiarity with key events on common IT platforms
* Basic understanding of Microsoft technologies, e.g. AD, Windows Server, Hyper V, Exchange O365, SQL Server, Microsoft Dynamics, IIS, Azure and web hosting


**Key Attributes:**
* Strong ownership and accountability mindset. (SRE Mindset)
* Willing to work in rotational shifts including nights shifts and on\-call.
* Ability to thrive in high\-pressure, fast\-paced environments.
* Excellent collaboration skills with cross\-functional and cross\-regional teams.
* Commitment to operational excellence and continuous learning.
* Natural bar\-raiser: curious and passionate, with a desire to continuously learn more.


**Preferred Certifications (Not Mandatory)**
 CCNP, ITIL, Fortinet, Palo Alto \& Cloud Certifications
   

  

**What would set you apart?**
 Previous hands\-on working experience with Meraki \& Palo Alto network gear

 The IT Infrastructure Engineer is responsible for the design, implementation, and maintenance of Deel’s core internal infrastructure.  To be successful as a Software Engineer \- BA4 you should have experience with:

title: Software Engineer - Platforms & Productivity
description:
**About Us**
 At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.
   

  

 At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI\-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.
   

  

**Available Locations: Bengaluru**
**About The Department**
 Cloudflare’s Engineering Team builds and runs the software that handles large amounts of requests on the Internet today. We also build and run the internal tools and platforms that run that software. Individual engineering teams are typically responsible for large areas with considerable impact, and able to execute autonomously within that space to deliver value to their customers \- be they internal or external.
   

  

**About The Team And The Role**
 The Engineering Platform and Productivity team has a charter to build a self\-service, resilient, and scalable platform using a combination of Open Source projects, intellectual property, and internal infrastructure. The charter includes to build tools and services that help easily integrate a base set of capabilities into Cloudflare’s products. These services have cross cutting concerns that 100s of fellow engineers use as the building blocks at Cloudflare. The team also writes services that are redundant for each product development team to build and that serve high volumes of requests every day.
   

  

 As an engineer in the Engineering Productivity and Platforms organization, you'll be building and managing tools to help engineers deploy and operate the services that make Cloudflare work. Our mission is to provide a reliable, yet flexible, platform to help product teams release new software efficiently and safely. The role includes both software engineering and DevOps operational responsibilities. The ideal candidate will care deeply about providing other engineers with an excellent development experience.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
* Design and build developer productivity tooling including MCP servers and agents.
* Drive initiatives that make our engineers happier and more productive.
* Help respond and prevent incidents impacting core platforms.
* Harden the platform against security threats and resource contention issues.
* Improve our GitOps systems and practices.
* Work with app teams to understand their potential challenges and help them choose the best way to architect their systems.


**Desirable Skills, Knowledge And Experience.**
* Ability to work with codebases in Bash, TypeScript and Go.
* Excellent debugging skills.
* Source control experience including branching, merging and rebasing.
* The ability to break down complex problems into smaller pieces, provide options, talk through trade\-offs and drive the effort to solve the problem.


**Bonus Points**
* Providing guidance and building platforms across multiple zones and regions as foundation for other teams to build distributed highly\-available applications.
* Worked in a platform engineering team/ engineering productivity team in the past.


 Fraud Alert: Do not fall victim to recruitment fraud. Cloudflare never charges application fees or requires candidates to purchase third\-party certifications or training as a condition of employment. All official communication comes strictly from @cloudflare.com email addresses.
   

  

**What Makes Cloudflare Special?**
 We’re not just a highly ambitious, large\-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large\-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.
   

  

**Project Galileo** 
 : Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers\-\-at no cost.
   

  

**Athenian Project** 
 : In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.
   

  

**1\.1\.1\.1** 
 : We released 1\.1\.1\.1 to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy\-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use \- it is the first consumer\-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal \- we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our privacy commitment and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.
   

  

 Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!
   

  

 This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.
   

  

 Cloudflare is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all people and place great value in both diversity and inclusiveness. All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to their, or any other person's, perceived or actual race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care status, or any other basis protected by law. We are an AA/Veterans/Disabled Employer.
   

  

 Cloudflare provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities. Please tell us if you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job. Examples of reasonable accommodations include, but are not limited to, changing the application process, providing documents in an alternate format, using a sign language interpreter, or using specialized equipment. If you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job, please contact us via e\-mail at hr@cloudflare.com or via mail at 101 Townsend St. San Francisco, CA 94107\.
