title: Global Inclusion Lead
description:
Job Description:
**Global Inclusion Lead****Location: Flexible / Global**  

**Travel: \~10%**  

At Schneider Electric, we are committed to creating an environment where everyone feels valued, respected, and empowered to contribute their best.  

  

The **Global Inclusion Lead** shapes and delivers Schneider Electric’s global inclusion strategy, embedding inclusion “by design” into how we lead, hire, develop, and recognize talent. You’ll operate in a highly matrixed, international environment—working across cultures, functions, and time zones—to drive measurable progress and strengthen our impact internally and externally as part of our Inclusion and Care By Design strategy.  

  

**Reporting line**  

This role reports to the Inclusion and Care VP within the Global Talent, Inclusion and Culture team.  

  

**What You’ll Do**  

* **Lead Global Inclusion Strategy**


Design and implement Schneider Electric’s inclusion strategy to advance equal chances of success at every level, aligned with business priorities internally and externally. Focus areas may include gender equity, race and ethnicity, LGBTQ\+ inclusion, inclusive leadership, and other locally relevant dimensions of diversity.  

  

* **Hardwire Inclusion into Processes and Behaviors**


Integrate inclusive practices into talent management, recruitment, performance development, and leadership development. Develop policies and practical toolkits that build awareness, capability, and accountability for inclusion across all levels, in close partnership with Care By Design.  

  

* **Lead the Global Gender Equity Strategy (Pipeline \+ Environment)**


Lead Schneider Electric’s global gender equity strategy to strengthen an inclusive, caring environment for women and improve outcomes across the end\-to\-end pipeline.  

Own progress on the Schneider Sustainability Impact (SSI) ambition of 40% women in leadership roles (currently 32%), translating the ambition into measurable milestones and business\-relevant actions.  

Use quantitative and qualitative insights to identify where outcomes diverge across processes or parts of the organization (e.g., hiring, progression, performance development, retention), and partner with leaders to address root challenges.  

Build senior\-stakeholder alignment across HR, business leaders, and key communities to mobilize coordinated action and sustained accountability.  

  

* **Governance, Reporting \& Measurement**


Establish governance frameworks, track progress, and report on key metrics to ensure transparency and continuous improvement. Lead inclusion\-related reporting inputs for the Schneider Sustainability Impact (SSI), CSRD, the Annual report, and other corporate compliance and reporting requirements. You will have the opportunity to present to HR leadership.  

  

* **Build and Manage External Partnerships**


Act as a global ambassador for inclusion, engaging with organizations such as UN Women, WBCSD, and WEF, and managing strategic partnerships.  

  

* **Collaborate on Communications**


Work closely with internal and external Communications teams to deliver impactful messaging and storytelling on inclusion.  

  

* **How You’ll Work (Intercultural \+ Time Zones)**


Collaborate with teams and senior stakeholders across regions, cultures, and functions.  

Facilitate dialogue across different communication norms and decision\-making styles.  

Plan and run global meetings across time zones, using clear pre\-reads, inclusive facilitation, and follow\-through to keep momentum.  

  

**Key stakeholders and partnerships**  

You will build strong working relationships across a broad stakeholder ecosystem, including:  

* HR committee members
* Talent managers
* Inclusion and Care SPOCs in each entity
* Communications
* People Analytics
* HRBPs
* Business leaders and people managers across the organization
* External partners and coalitions
  

(External) English Qualifications:
**What You Can Bring (You don’t have to have all of these to apply)** **IMPORTANT:**
The experience and skills listed are exhaustive. You do NOT have to match with all of them to apply. Use your judgement* Strategic Leadership: Ability to design and execute global strategies that influence culture and deliver measurable outcomes.
* Change Leadership: Skilled in driving cultural and behavioral change across diverse geographies.
* Data Fluency: Strong analytical skills to interpret data, set KPIs, and communicate insights effectively.
* Inclusive Communication: Ability to communicate across cultures and levels using accessible, inclusive language.
* Intercultural Effectiveness: Curiosity and adaptability to work globally while tailoring approaches to local context.
* Collaboration \& Influence: Proven track record of building partnerships and influencing senior stakeholders without direct authority.

  

**Experience**  

Demonstrated experience driving transformation and solving complex, ambiguous problems in a global environment with multiple stakeholders, ideally within Inclusion \& Diversity, HR, culture transformation, or an adjacent field such as social impact. Multi\-regional or global experience in complex stakeholder environments is a plus.  

  

**Personal Attributes**  

Commitment to fair change at scale. Cultural agility and openness to diverse perspectives. Resilience and adaptability in a fast\-changing environment.  

  

**Scope Note**  

Disability inclusion and accessibility are managed through a dedicated team; this role partners closely to ensure alignment and avoid gaps.

title: Sr Software Development Engineer, Workforce Planning
description:
**Your work days are brighter here.**
We’re obsessed with making hard work pay off, for our people, our customers, and the world around us. As a Fortune 500 company and a leading AI platform for managing people, money, and agents, we’re shaping the future of work so teams can reach their potential and focus on what matters most. The minute you join, you’ll feel it. Not just in the products we build, but in how we show up for each other. Our culture is rooted in integrity, empathy, and shared enthusiasm. We’re in this together, tackling big challenges with bold ideas and genuine care. We look for curious minds and courageous collaborators who bring sun\-drenched optimism and drive. Whether you're building smarter solutions, supporting customers, or creating a space where everyone belongs, you’ll do meaningful work with Workmates who’ve got your back. In return, we’ll give you the trust to take risks, the tools to grow, the skills to develop and the support of a company invested in you for the long haul. So, if you want to inspire a brighter work day for everyone, including yourself, you’ve found a match in Workday, and we hope to be a match for you too.**About the Team**
In the Workday Adaptive Planning team, we help organizations plan, model, and execute their most critical business decisions. Our Workforce Planning products sit at the intersection of Finance and HR, enabling customers to align headcount, skills, cost, and organizational structure with their strategic objectives. Built on a powerful, in\-memory planning platform, our solutions support dynamic, company‑wide planning, rich what‑if modeling, and analytics at scale to help customers navigate ongoing workforce transformation.  

  

The Workforce Planning product area focuses on strategic workforce planning and task intelligence: enabling customers to connect long‑term business strategy to workforce demand and supply, understand the work itself (tasks, roles, and skills), and optimize how that work gets done across people, teams, and time. Capabilities include headcount and cost planning, skills and role\-based planning, task\- and activity\-level modeling, scenario modeling for organizational change, integration with HCM/HRIS and financial systems, and intuitive experiences for HR, finance, and business leaders to collaborate on workforce decisions.  

  

More importantly, we are adding AI/ML product capabilities to new and existing Workforce Planning products. This includes building agents and skills that interpret user inputs and constraints, explain trade\-offs, summarize decision contexts, and generate recommended organizational scenarios. Our goal is to enable business leaders to quickly explore structural options with guidance, rather than just raw tools, so they can focus on driving necessary changes in their organizations.**About the Role**
We are looking for an experienced full\-stack engineer who is proficient in developing scalable and rich web applications to join our growing team. Your primary focus will be to build out scalable and performant backend services and the necessary APIs that will help expedite implementations and improve the user experience for our customers.* Solve hard technical problems with optimism and positivity while also being a great teammate
* Contribute to engineering excellence through effective and fast\-paced Agile development with high bar for quality and best coding practices
* Work with engineering support teams to address customer escalations
* Work with multi\-functional team in designing interfaces
* Write reliable unit, integration, and system level tests that will run on our CI/CD automation pipelines.
* Mentor and learn from other team members through pairing, code reviews, knowledge shares, hackathons, etc.

**About You**
We are seeking an experienced software engineer to collaborate in a fast paced agile environment and open to learning new languages.
Basic Qualification:* 8\+ years experience in software development engineering, architecting, building, and scaling robust and efficient software systems.
* 8\+ experience in object oriented programming languages and technologies (Java, C\#, Python, Scala).
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.


Other Qualification:* Team Leadership and/or Agile leadership experience
* Experience with metadata\-driven development, contributing to highly configurable and adaptable platforms
* Experience with integration technologies (e.g., RESTful APIs, message queues)
* Exposure to modern UI technologies and languages (e.g, React, Typescript, JavaScript)
* A deep understanding of software engineering principles (e.g., design patterns, data structures, algorithms) and their application
* A code quality champion and advocate with a strong understanding of test automation principles
* Proven ability to lead Team Collaboration within a software development team and mentor junior engineers.

 **Our Approach to Flexible Work**  

With Flex Work, we’re combining the best of both worlds: in\-person time and remote. Our approach enables our teams to deepen connections, maintain a strong community, and do their best work. We know that flexibility can take shape in many ways, so rather than a number of required days in\-office each week, we simply **spend at least half (50%) of our time each quarter in the office or in the field** with our customers, prospects, and partners (depending on role). This means you'll have the freedom to create a flexible schedule that caters to your business, team, and personal needs, while being intentional to make the most of time spent together. Those in our remote "home office" roles also have the opportunity to come together in our offices for important moments that matter.  

At Workday, we are committed to providing an accessible and inclusive hiring experience where all candidates can fully demonstrate their skills. If you require assistance or an accommodation at any point, please email accommodations@workday.com.**Are you being referred to one of our roles? If so, ask your connection at Workday about our Employee Referral process!**
At Workday, we value our candidates’ privacy and data security. Workday will never ask candidates to apply to jobs through websites that are not Workday Careers.  

Please be aware of sites that may ask for you to input your data in connection with a job posting that appears to be from Workday but is not.  

In addition, Workday will never ask candidates to pay a recruiting fee, or pay for consulting or coaching services, in order to apply for a job at Workday.

More importantly, we are adding AI/ML product capabilities to new and existing Workforce Planning products. This includes building agents and skills that interpret user inputs and constraints, explain trade\-offs, summarize decision contexts, and generate recommended organizational scenarios. * Excellent analytical and problem solving skills.
* Strong communication skills, able to explain system behavior and design choices to non technical stakeholders.

title: Senior Talent Acquisition Coordinator
description:
We are a global team of innovators and pioneers dedicated to shaping the future of observability. At New Relic, we build an intelligent platform that empowers companies to thrive in an AI\-first world by giving them unparalleled insight into their complex systems. As we continue to expand our global footprint, we're looking for passionate people to join our mission. If you're ready to help the world's best companies optimize their digital applications, we invite you to explore a career with us!

**About the role**

  

As a Talent Acquisition Coordinator at New Relic, you will play a pivotal role in making sure each applicant has a world\-class experience from start to finish. As the primary point of contact for our candidates, you will act as a brand ambassador, demonstrating our values in all of your interactions. As the go\-to person for all things related to scheduling and candidate experience, you will be a close partner with our recruiters, hiring managers, and other members of our TA team. Our dynamic talent acquisition team encourages ambitious ideas. We will look to you and our team of Coordinators to drive and improve our interview process!

  


**Responsibilities:**
* Partner with hiring managers and recruiters to schedule phone and video interviews in a fast\-paced environment.
* Correspond with candidates via Zoom, by email, or over the phone to answer their questions and help them move through the interview process.
* Host candidates during virtual interviews, giving them a window into our extraordinary work environment as you lead them through schedules you've organized
* Post open roles to external job boards as requested.
* Find opportunities to improve our candidate experience and streamline our scheduling process.
* Collaborate with the larger PeopleOps team on projects to improve candidate experience.
* Support recruitment events, meet\-ups, and other talent branding and event needs.

**Requirements:**
* At least 5\+ years of experience in the Recruiting space or similar field.
* Skilled at managing multiple, competing priorities.
* Be unfazed by last\-minute changes and can easily navigate shifting priorities.
* Ability to problem solve and find creative solutions independently and as well as part of a team.
* Excellent and timely communication skills with all collaborators including candidates, recruiters, and hiring managers.
* Ability to maintain confidentiality and apply appropriate tact.
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience.
* Prior scheduling \& calendar management experience.
* Experience with Mac OS, Applicant Tracking Systems and Google Suite.

Fostering a diverse, welcoming and inclusive environment is important to us. We work hard to make everyone feel comfortable bringing their best, most authentic selves to work every day. We celebrate our talented Relics’ different backgrounds and abilities, and recognize the different paths they took to reach us – including nontraditional ones. Their experiences and perspectives inspire us to make our products and company the best they can be. We’re looking for people who feel connected to our mission and values, not just candidates who check off all the boxes.



If you require a reasonable accommodation to complete any part of the application or recruiting process, please reach out to resume@newrelic.com.



We believe in empowering all Relics to achieve professional and business success through a flexible workforce model. This model allows us to work in a variety of workplaces that best support our success, including fully office\-based, fully remote, or hybrid.


**Our hiring process**  

  

In compliance with applicable law, all persons hired will be required to verify identity and eligibility to work and to complete employment eligibility verification. Note: Our stewardship of the data of thousands of customers means that a criminal background check is required to join New Relic.  

  

We will consider qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records based on individual circumstances and in accordance with applicable law including, but not limited to, the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance.  

  

Headhunters and recruitment agencies may not submit resumes/CVs through this website or directly to managers. New Relic does not accept unsolicited headhunter and agency resumes, and will not pay fees to any third\-party agency or company that does not have a signed agreement with New Relic.



New Relic develops and distributes encryption software and technology that complies with U.S. export controls and licensing requirements. title: Human Resources Manager
description:
**About H.P. Singh Agencies**

H.P. Singh Agencies is a 50\+ year\-old textile trading and retail house based in Delhi, managing over 80,000 SKUs across cotton, silk, brocade, ikat, linen, and digitally printed fabrics. We serve export houses, fashion designers, boutiques, and walk\-in retail customers from our Nehru Place flagship store, supported by multiple warehouses in Okhla. The company is in the middle of a significant digital transformation — implementing Odoo ERP, CRM systems, and data\-driven operations — and the people function needs to keep pace.

**About the Role**

We have 100\+ employees and zero formal HR infrastructure. No employee handbook. No structured hiring pipeline. No appraisal system. No onboarding process. That is not a problem — it is your mandate.

We are hiring our first dedicated HR Manager to build the entire people function from the ground up. You will not inherit systems to maintain — you will create them. This role reports directly to the Director.

This is not a back\-office admin role. You will sit at the leadership table, influence hiring decisions across every department, and shape the culture of a company that is professionalizing rapidly while staying rooted in its 50\-year legacy. If you are the kind of person who gets energized by a blank canvas and has the discipline to fill it with real, working systems, read on.

**What You Will Build (Key Responsibilities)**

Phase 1 — Foundation (Month 1–3\)

* Conduct a full workforce audit: compile a complete employee master (roles, compensation, documents, statutory compliance status) across all locations
* Assess and close any PF, ESI, and labour law compliance gaps — at 100\+ employees, there is zero room for exposure here
* Establish a basic attendance and leave management system integrated with our existing workflows
* Standardise employment documentation: offer letters, appointment letters, confirmation letters, exit checklists
* Create a clear organogram reflecting actual reporting lines across store, warehouse, and office teams

Phase 2 — Systems (Month 3–6\)

* Design and launch a structured hiring pipeline, with distinct sourcing strategies for blue\-collar roles (warehouse packers, loaders, helpers) and white\-collar roles (merchandisers, sales executives, designers, operations staff)
* Build a proper onboarding programme — a new joiner at HP Singh should be productive and culturally oriented within their first two weeks, not left to figure things out
* Draft and implement the company's first Employee Handbook covering leave policy, code of conduct, working hours, disciplinary procedures, anti\-harassment policy (POSH), and grievance redressal
* Design a practical appraisal framework — simple, transparent, and tied to measurable outcomes, not paperwork for its own sake
* Provide accurate monthly inputs (attendance, deductions, new joiners, exits) to the CA firm handling payroll

Phase 3 — Talent \& Culture (Month 6–12\)

* Own the full recruitment lifecycle for critical hires across departments — from writing the brief, to sourcing, screening, interviewing, and closing
* Begin tracking attrition data and conducting structured exit interviews to identify patterns
* Develop a basic training calendar: product knowledge for new warehouse and store staff, soft skills for client\-facing roles, and compliance training
* Conduct a compensation benchmarking exercise — are we paying market rates, and where are we losing people?
* Collaborate with leadership to define HP Singh's employer brand and what makes us a compelling place to work

**Candidate Profile**

Experience: 5–10 years in an HR generalist role. Strong preference for candidates who have been the first or second HR hire at a company and have built processes from zero — not just operated within an existing framework.

Industry Fit: Retail, trading, distribution, textile/apparel, FMCG, or manufacturing backgrounds strongly preferred. You must be equally comfortable managing hiring and compliance for a warehouse floor team as you are recruiting a mid\-level sales or design professional.

Statutory Knowledge: Working knowledge of PF, ESI, Shops \& Establishment Act, Bonus Act, Gratuity Act, and POSH compliance. Delhi\-specific labour regulations is a strong plus.

Talent Eye: You do not just fill vacancies — you assess fit. You understand that a great resume does not equal a great hire, and you have the instinct and frameworks to evaluate ownership mindset, cultural alignment, and growth potential alongside technical skills.

Tech Comfort: Proficient with Google Workspace. Experience with HRMS/HRIS platforms (Zoho People, GreytHR, Keka, or similar) is a plus. You will eventually help bring HR data into our Odoo ERP ecosystem.

Personality: Independent, high\-ownership, structured, direct. You are comfortable building in ambiguity, pushing back respectfully when needed, and holding people — at every level — accountable to the systems you create.

**First 90\-Day KPIs**

* Complete employee master audit with 100% documentation across all locations
* Identify and close all critical PF/ESI/statutory compliance gaps
* Publish v1\.0 of the HP Singh Employee Handbook
* Hire at least 2 open positions end\-to\-end using a structured, documented process
* Present a 12\-month HR roadmap to the Director covering systems, hiring, compliance, and culture priorities

**Why This Role Matters**

Most companies this size already have an HR function. We are building ours now because we are serious about doing it right — not bolting on processes after the fact. You will not be maintaining someone else's system. You will be the person who defines how HP Singh manages, develops, and retains its people for the next decade.

**Keywords:** HR Manager, HR Generalist, HR Business Partner, HRBP, People Manager, Talent Acquisition, Employee Engagement, PF ESI Compliance, Labour Law, POSH, Employee Handbook, Policy Design, Onboarding, Performance Management, Appraisal, Recruitment, Textile HR, Retail HR, FMCG HR, Manufacturing HR, HRMS, Zoho People, GreytHR, Keka, Odoo, Google Workspace, Hiring, Workforce Planning, Training, Compensation Benchmarking, Exit Interview, Attrition, Attendance Management, Delhi

Job Overview  
A Botanist is a scientist who specializes in the study of plants. This role involves extensive research and experimentation to understand plant life, including their growth, genetic properties, ecological functions, and chemical makeup. Botanists work in various settings, from laboratories and greenhouses to outdoor environments, and often contribute to broader scientific knowledge, agricultural innovations, and conservation efforts. They may work independently or as part of a multidisciplinary team, addressing complex botanical questions and applying their findings to real\-world challenges.  
Botanist Responsibilities \& Duties

* Conducting field research to collect plant samples and data
* Analyzing plant genetics and conducting laboratory experiments
* Identifying and classifying new plant species
* Studying the effects of environmental changes on plant growth
* Publishing research findings in scientific journals
* Collaborating with other scientists and researchers
* Developing and maintaining botanical gardens or herbariums
* Providing expert advice on plant\-related issues to government and industry
* Teaching botany or related subjects at academic institutions
* Engaging in conservation efforts to protect endangered plant species
* Conducting experiments to understand plant diseases and pathogens
* Advising agricultural practices to improve crop yield and sustainability
* Utilizing advanced technologies for plant research such as genomics and molecular biology tools
* Preparing grant proposals to secure funding for research projects

title: Robotics Annotation
description:
**About Autonex**

Autonex is on a mission to build India’s most impactful deeptech company and become a global leader in applied AI. We’re reimagining how intelligent agents, robots, and automation systems learn, adapt, and operate in the real world.

Our work spans multiple domains from robotics and industrial automation to dental intelligence and autonomous decision\-making. At Autonex, you’ll work on cutting edge problems that push the boundaries of how AI thinks and acts in complex, real world environments.

We’re early. We’re ambitious. And we’re looking for exceptional people who want to learn fast, contribute meaningfully, and grow with us.

**The Role**

As a **Robotics Annotator**, you will be at the core of how our intelligent systems learn, reason, and improve. Your primary responsibility will be to **analyze, evaluate, and annotate the decision making trajectories of AI agents** ensuring that their outputs are accurate, logical, and aligned with intended outcomes.

This role is ideal for detail\-oriented, analytical thinkers who enjoy problem\-solving and want to gain hands\-on exposure to applied AI systems without needing a technical background. You will play a crucial role in improving AI reliability, enhancing real\-world performance, and ensuring that our models deliver measurable impact for clients.

If you love solving complex problems, thinking critically, and building something from 0 → 1 this role is for you.

**What You’ll Do**

* **Evaluate AI agent trajectories:** Examine the complete sequence of steps taken by AI agents to execute a given task, and determine whether the final output aligns with the prompt or objective.
* **Analyze model reasoning:** Dive deep into the decision making process followed by the agent to identify where it succeeded or failed, understanding the logic behind each action or choice.
* **Identify and classify errors:** Spot incorrect reasoning steps, logic gaps, or decision flaws and categorize them accurately based on defined guidelines.
* **Annotate with precision:** Record success/failure outcomes, mark errors, and input structured feedback on both internal annotation tools and external client platforms.
* **Ensure high\-quality outputs:** Consistently achieve and maintain annotation accuracy above 90%, ensuring that model evaluation data is reliable and actionable.

The Computer Operator will be responsible for managing day\-to\-day data entry, maintaining project files, and tracking solar plant performance. * **Team Support:** Coordinate with on\-site technicians to digitize material requisition slips and site completion certificates.

**4\. General Office \& IT Support**

* Routine scanning, printing, email management, and document formatting (MS Word/Excel).
* Perform regular data backups to prevent the loss of critical project data.

* Proficient in **MS Excel** (formulas, tables, formatting) and **MS Word**.
* Familiarity with Email, PDF converters, scanning, and printing.

* **Soft Skills:** High typing speed, strong attention to detail, and good organizational skills.
